children: Public disclosure of inside information according to article 17 MAR München (pta/09.09.2026/11:25) - GenH2 Corp. Closes Sale-And-Lease-Back Transaction Generated Funds Secure Future Production and R&D BERLIN, GERMANY, and TITUSVILLE, FL (September 9, 2026) —GenH2 Corp., a leader in hydrogen infrastructure solutions and a 100% subsidiary of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, closed a sale-and-leaseback transaction with a private investor. In the transaction, GenH2 sold its headquarters office building and its manufacturing center in Titusville, Florida, USA, resulting in proceeds to the company in the mid single-digit millions USD (including amounts for improvements to the manufacturing building). The funds generated out of this transaction will be used to fund GenH2's commercial growth and support the manufacturing of its existing backlog, as well as to invest in further R&D work. The new lease became effective on 8 September 2026. End of adhoc release About GenH2 GenH2 ( https://genh2hydrogen.com/) Corp. is a subsidiary of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, a German company listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. GenH2 is a technology leader in liquid hydrogen infrastructure systems, including Zero-Loss Controlled Storage and advanced hydrogen liquefaction. The company focuses on the production of standardized equipment to speed midstream infrastructure buildout for hard-to-decarbonize sectors. The technology team includes former NASA Hall-of-Fame scientists with decades of experience researching, engineering, and building hydrogen solutions. Learn more about GenH2 at https://genh2.com/. About Path2 Hydrogen AG Path2 Hydrogen AG

is a management holding company with a focus on the hydrogen infrastructure sector. The Company aims to create a vertically integrated hydrogen ecosystem supporting global energy transition objectives. In early 2025, Path2 Hydrogen acquired GenH2 Corp., a company specializing in liquid hydrogen technology and equipment.
